## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek man who is widely regarded as lacking in willpower. He is commonly referred to by others primarily in relation to his wife.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013)_

## History

Thomas Lynde spent his early life ruled by his mother until he married [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who then assumed control over him. At the time of his marriage, Thomas planted June lilies for his new wife. He eventually passed away, leaving [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) widowed and prompting her to move in with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Relationships

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). By the end of the school term, their household remains connected to the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) community, with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visiting [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to praise Anne's growth and personal development.

- Spouse of — married couple  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Their shared household and circumstances are discussed alongside community affairs by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is deeply involved in local gossip and neighborhood events, frequently visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to offer opinions on the Cuthberts' affairs, including their adoption of an orphan and the care of the Keith twins.

- Spouse of — husband  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), +7 more</sub>
